title: **Farewell, Papa Chris** 🕊️
paragraphs: With a heavy heart, we say goodbye to Papa Chris. May your soul rest in peace with God.

Pagkawala sa akong mga ginikanan, ikaw ang nahimong ikaduhang amahan sa among pamilya. Dako kaayo among pagpasalamat sa imong kaayo, kaalam, ug walay puas nga suporta. Your presence filled our lives with warmth and love, and we will always cherish the memories we made together.
**"The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit." - Psalm 34:18**
Salamat kaayo sa imong paggiyang kanamo sa among darkest times. Mamingawon ka namo, pero ang imong espiritu magpabilin sa among kasingkasing.
**"Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted." - Matthew 5:4**
Rest in peace, Papa Chris. Until we meet again. 💔
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)
